title: [E-Document] [Payables Agent] Users can personalize-in the Name column on the draft page
summary: The E-Document purchase draft lines subform now includes a read-only Name column showing the matched entity (Item, G/L Account, or Resource), hidden by default but available for personalization to help reviewers verify line matching.
key_points: Added read-only Name column to E-Doc. Purchase Draft Subform page displaying matched entity names
Column is hidden by default and users can personalize it into view
Shows the matched record name rather than extracted invoice description
Value computed dynamically in OnAfterGetRecord with no table schema changes
New OnAfterGetMatchedEntityName integration event for connector apps
quote: shows the name of the matched entity such as Item, G/L Account, or Resource
